criteria: The file is one self-contained CHIP-8 interpreter (no libraries): all 35 instructions, 4 KB of memory, 16 registers, index register, stack, delay and sound timers, the 16-key keypad mapped to the keyboard, a 64x32 display drawn on a scaled canvas with correct sprite XOR and collision, a built-in demo ROM as a byte array that actually runs, ROM loading from a file, pause, single step, adjustable speed, and a debugger panel showing the registers and the current instruction. The instructions must be decoded and executed for real, never faked.

review.description: Single-file CHIP-8 emulator: full instruction set, timers, keypad, 64x32 canvas display with sprite collision, built-in demo ROM, ROM loading, pause, step, speed control, register debugger.
